frozen_candidate_root_contribution: A handful-sized clump of multiple heterogeneous strands grasped/gathered together into one bound bundle; hence, by extension, a tangle of disparate elements jumbled into a single unsorted mass.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: A handful-sized clump of multiple heterogeneous strands grasped/gathered together into one bound bundle; hence, by extension, a tangle of disparate elements jumbled into a single unsorted mass.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Only 3 occurrences, all nominal (form N), and they split into two sense-families that both resolve to one image. (1) 38:44 gives the concrete, surface sense: "وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِ" — Job is told to take in his hand a ḍighth and strike with it. A ḍighth is precisely a handful/bunch — a bundle of stalks or twigs gathered together into one graspable clump. The word denotes the bound, hand-sized aggregate of several strands, not a single item. (2) 12:44 and 21:5 give the plural أَضْغَاث in the fixed phrase "أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍ" — the king's dream (12:44) and the Prophet's revelation (21:5) are dismissed as "aḍghāth of dreams," i.e. a tangled bundle of mixed dream-fragments, incoherent precisely because it is a heap of disparate strands with no single sortable thread. The invariant across all three is the "bound clump of many mixed strands": literally a fistful of stalks (38:44), metaphorically a fistful of jumbled dream-material (12:44, 21:5). The "confusedness" foregrounded in the dream verses is not an extra root meaning but the natural effect of the root's own image — heterogeneous strands packed into one handful cannot be told apart.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: FORM: all three are form N (noun); the only morphological variation is number — singular ضِغْثًا (38:44) vs. broken plural أَضْغَاث (12:44, 21:5). Number is a form layer, not root content; both denote the same bundle-unit (one clump vs. clumps). CONSTRUCTION: 38:44 is a direct accusative object of خُذ ("take") reinforced by بِيَدِكَ ("in your hand") — a physical-grasping frame; 12:44 and 21:5 are the iḍāfa/construct "أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍ" functioning as predicate in a قَالُوا ("they said") speech frame. The grasping vector and the construct-with-'dreams' both belong to construction, not to the root. PARTICIPANTS: stalks/twigs handled by Job vs. dream-content ascribed to a sleeper/a dismissed messenger — participant identity subtracted. CONTEXT: oath-fulfillment narrative (38), dream-interpretation narrative (12), polemical denial of revelation (21) — subtracted. After removing number-morphology, the grasp/construct frames, participants, and genre, the residue in every case is the "bound handful of many mixed strands."
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 38:44 (ضِغْثًا, the handful of stalks) is the hardest because it carries none of the "confusion/incoherence" that dominates the dream verses — it is a tidy, purposeful bundle used to strike. This threatens any hypothesis that the root core is "confusedness." It reconciles cleanly, however, under the bundle reading: the root supplies "handful of gathered mixed strands," and 38:44 is exactly that at the literal level; the confusion in 12:44/21:5 is the same image applied to mental content, where a bundle of heterogeneous strands reads as an incoherent jumble. The concrete occurrence thus anchors the core and the abstract ones extend from it — no contradiction, only a determinate concrete→metaphorical direction.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The strongest alternative is that the root core is abstract "confusedness / jumbledness" (the salient force in two of three tokens, both being the idiom أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍ). Internal evidence arbitrates against making abstraction the core: 38:44 exhibits a physical bundle with zero confusion, so the concrete "handful of mixed strands" reading generates the confusion sense (mixed strands in one clump = unsortable) whereas "confusedness" cannot generate the concrete striking-bundle of 38:44. The concrete-bundle hypothesis therefore covers all 3; the abstract-confusion hypothesis fails on 38:44. Direction of derivation is fixed by the data.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest semantic neighbors: خ ل ط (xalaṭa, generic 'mixing/blending' of substances) and ق ب ض / ك ف ف (qabaḍa, kaffa, 'grasping/holding in the hand'). Dgv is distinct from خ ل ط in that it does not name the act or state of mixing per se but a discrete COUNTABLE UNIT — a hand-sized bound clump (it pluralizes as أَضْغَاث, 'bundles'); and distinct from ق ب ض/grasping roots in that the grasping in 38:44 is supplied by خُذ + بِيَدِك (construction), while Dgv contributes the OBJECT grasped — the aggregated strand-bundle itself, characterized by internal multiplicity/heterogeneity that generic 'handful' roots lack. Falsifiability: the core would fail if a Dgv occurrence denoted a single homogeneous item, or pure abstract confusion with no bundling/aggregation, or the act of mixing without a discrete gathered unit.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty contribution — "a bound handful of many mixed strands / a gathered clump of heterogeneous elements" — is recoverable in all 3 occurrences and is contradicted by none. It is surface-literal in 38:44 (the fistful of stalks) and metaphorical in 12:44/21:5 (the fistful of jumbled dream-fragments), with a determinate concrete→abstract direction the data itself fixes (the concrete token cannot be derived from an abstract 'confusion' core, but the abstract tokens follow naturally from the concrete bundle). Strength is MODERATE rather than STRONG because two of the three tokens are the same fixed idiom أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍ and depend on a metaphorical extension for which the bridge, while coherent and internally motivated by 38:44's literal bundle, is inferential rather than explicitly attested within a single verse; only one occurrence carries the sense on the surface. The unity holds without forcing across the hardest case (38:44), so the disposition is PREFERRED.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial sweep of all 3 (all form N). 38:44 ضِغْثًا (sg): Job takes a ḍighth in hand to strike — concrete handful/bunch of stalks. Classical lexica (Lisān, Ṣiḥāḥ) define ضغث as a handful of grass MIXED wet-with-dry (qabḍa min ḥashīsh mukhtaliṭ), so the candidate's 'heterogeneous strands bound into one handful' is lexically grounded, not imported. 12:44 and 21:5 both in the fixed phrase أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍ (pl): dreams/revelation dismissed as jumbled bundles of dream-fragments — the plural of the mixed-handful noun yielding 'tangled heaps.' Metaphorical extension follows directly from the literal image; no ad-hoc bridge needed. Hardest case: whether 'mixed/heterogeneous' is genuinely present in 38:44 or over-read — a skeptic could argue the Job-bundle foregrounds COUNT (many stalks, one strike to satisfy the oath) over heterogeneity. Resolved: the shared invariant 'handful-sized bound clump of many strands' is uncontested across all three, and the mixed-quality sits inside the root's own dictionary definition, so no circular rescue is required; the difference is foregrounding, not contradiction. Neighbor contrast: discriminates against Hzm (tied bundle, no mixing), qbD (act of grasping), xlT (generic mixing without handful/bundle constraint). ضغث uniquely fuses handful-sized + bound + mixed strands. Falsification condition (any occurrence not resolving to a bundle/handful/jumble) is clear and unmet. No genuine failing occurrence.

occurrence_dispositions.note: أَضْغَٰثُ in "أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍ" (the king's dream dismissed as a jumbled bundle of dream-fragments) — plural of ضِغْث, a handful of mixed strands; the confusedness is the natural effect of heterogeneous strands packed into one heap. Candidate residue recoverable.

أَضْغَٰثُ in "أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍ" (revelation dismissed as a tangle of mixed dream-material) — same fixed phrase; incoherence flows from disparate strands bound into one unsortable clump. Candidate residue present.
ضِغْثًا in "وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِ" — the concrete literal sense: a hand-sized bunch/fistful of stalks gathered into one graspable clump; the root's core image undiluted.
